result.title: The role of injected noise in diffusion model generalization
result.comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, published at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: 2nd Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
result.summary: Diffusion models trained on distinct datasets can produce highly similar samples when prompted with the same noise input, suggesting that they learn a generalized data distribution. We investigate the role of noise injected during the sampling process, and show that it plays an important role in making or breaking this strong generalization effect. Based on this finding we investigate the robustness of sample similarity to changes in the injected noise, and find that its impact is largest in the sampling regime where broad structure already exists but the precise identity of the sample is not yet determined.

AI.brief_summary: 该文考察扩散模型采样中注入噪声的作用，发现同一噪声提示下不同数据集训练的模型仍产生高度相似样本，且噪声对样本相似度的影响在「已有粗结构但样本身份未定」的采样阶段最强。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及视觉推理，但其中「采样早期结构先形成、身份后确定」的阶段性结论，可能可供核查 diffusion 式 latent 推理中随机状态更新与推理状态何时收敛、何时应停止的关系。
